scope: Historical Windows R36 native code-dispatch behavior with current protocol adapter and a synthetic loopback provider; does not qualify later capacity-recovery native builds

postvalid.native_opt_in: tools.update_plan.enabled=true in own profile; CodeMode unchanged

interpretation: The undeclared call is rejected before native dispatch.
Native retries retain an already-executed valid call and its output in the next request.
The controlled retry returned only a final answer and did not automatically re-execute the historical tool.
This does not establish idempotence if a provider emits another tool call or reuses a call ID; no such replay was injected.
